title: Utilization of a biosorbent derived from plant residues for the treatment of water contaminated with rhodamine B: preparation and characterization
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,43038-43052
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07130E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ahlem Sarra Saadi, Djihane Slimane Ben Ali, Salim Bousba
An eco-friendly biosorbent made from oak shells was developed and used to remove rhodamine B from water, showing the promise of natural waste materials for sustainable wastewater treatment.
